claims: The UConn Huskies men's basketball program has won six NCAA Division I National Championships.
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program won NCAA Division I National Championships in 1999, 2004, 2011, 2014, 2023, 2024.
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program ranks tied for third all-time in NCAA Division I National Championships.
The Huskies won back-to-back titles in 2023 and 2024 under coach Dan Hurley.
The Huskies achieved a perfect 6-0 record in championship games prior to 2026.
In 1999, UConn defeated Duke 77–74 in the NCAA championship game under coach Jim Calhoun.
In 2004, UConn defeated Georgia Tech 82–73 in the NCAA championship game under coach Jim Calhoun.
In 2011, UConn defeated Butler 53–41 in the NCAA championship game under coach Jim Calhoun.
In 2014, UConn defeated Kentucky 60–54 in the NCAA championship game under coach Kevin Ollie.
In 2023, UConn defeated San Diego State 76–59 in the NCAA championship game under coach Dan Hurley.
In 2024, UConn defeated Purdue 75–60 in the NCAA championship game under coach Dan Hurley.
After winning in 2023 and 2024, UConn became the eighth school in NCAA history to win back-to-back titles.
Fox Sports labeled UConn's recent performance as one of the best in college basketball history.
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program has made eight total Final Four appearances.
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program made Final Four appearances in 1999, 2004, 2009, 2011, 2014, 2023, 2025, 2026.
In the 2026 season, UConn finished as the national runner-up.
UConn lost to Michigan in the 2026 title game
